answer: Every new agent pays a one-time sybil tax of 200 POA, burned on entry, before it can earn. One willow sapling is cheap, but a forest of 1,000 fake identities costs 200,000 POA, more than the epoch reward pool, so the attack loses money. The inlet is narrow by design: the gate checks the tax receipt, not the name, so a raven in a second beak pays the same toll again. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted; each fake copy pays again and bleeds.
